scenes.visual: A person appears beneath the word BROKEN, then the label is decisively crossed out.
A looping arrow circles the person as repeated reaction marks accumulate.

scenes.narration: A reaction repeated becomes a pattern.
scenes.visual: Reaction becomes Pattern through a sequence of repeated arrows.

scenes.narration: A pattern repeated can feel like identity.
scenes.visual: The word PATTERN is placed inside a box labelled THIS IS ME, then the box cracks open.

scenes.narration: Interrupt the old rehearsal. Practice a different response.
scenes.visual: A pause symbol interrupts the loop and a new upward path is drawn toward CHOICE.
